case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Coffee Clip Exact URL Ending
tests: Checks an exact case-sensitive URL rendered legibly on a timed end card rather than merely mentioned in the reply.

faults.what: The end card contains a large white rectangle and a gray horizontal band instead of a plain black background.
The URL is oversized and clipped at both frame edges, so its beginning and ending cannot be read or verified.

judge.summary: The silent vertical clip shows a convincing coffee pour, but the end card has the wrong background and a severely cropped URL.

must_haves.item: The first approximately 5 seconds show a close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup.
must_haves.why: The 1-second and 3-second frames show coffee pouring into a ceramic cup, with a visibly rising liquid level.

must_haves.item: The final approximately 3 seconds are a plain black end card.
must_haves.why: The 5-second and 7-second frames show a large white panel and gray band within black margins.

must_haves.item: The end card reads exactly 'https://example.com/Go?ref=June', preserving uppercase G and J, the colon, slashes, question mark and equals sign.
must_haves.why: Both ends of the URL are cropped, preventing the complete exact text from appearing readably.

must_haves.item: The URL is centered in white on one line, fully inside the frame and readable throughout the end card.
must_haves.why: The text is white and on one line, but extends beyond both sides of the frame in both end-card samples.

must_haves.item: No other written text appears anywhere in the video.
must_haves.why: No text other than the URL is visible in the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 9:16 and approximately 8 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames have a 9:16 vertical format, and the supplied metadata confirms an 8-second duration with no audible sound.
